meta.provenance: CL empirical inventory (t/3447#1) over 916 POV nodes + 33744 edges; structure TL (t/3447#2/#4); SO-approved HLD (e/151#2, conditions t/3447#5).
meta.note: Defines the SHAPE of the taxonomy — attribute names/types/value-sets, the canonical edge vocabulary, and the node-ID grammar. NOT per-node content; per-node data, embeddings metadata, and policy_actions internals are out of scope.
meta.snapshot_fields_note: Fields suffixed _at_snapshot and the `contested` resolution pointers are INFORMATIONAL only — never gate inputs. The drift gate compares value-sets and types, never coverage/snapshot fields (t/3447#4 tweak 1).

change_control.rule: Normative-field edits — enums, types, value-sets, edge vocabulary, node-ID grammar, deprecated_types — require CL+TL co-sign and re-trigger the t/3361 mandatory Second Opinion when they meet its bar. Non-normative edits (notes, *_at_snapshot values, contested resolution pointers) are free.
change_control.semver: major = normative removal or retype; minor = additive normative (new enum value / attribute / edge type); patch = non-normative (notes, snapshot values, pointers).
change_control.this_block_is_normative: This change_control block is itself co-signed content — do not alter it without CL+TL sign-off (SO condition 1, t/3447#5).

meta.record_first_workflow: A legitimate new value is NOT a gate failure to suppress — add it to THIS record first (CL+TL co-sign per change_control), then the consumer. The drift gate's failure message restates this (SO condition 4, t/3447#5).
meta.net_not_gate: A green drift gate means NO DIVERGENCE between consumers and this record — NOT that the schema is correct. The record can be wrong yet consistently consumed; green attests consistency, not correctness (SO risk 1, t/3447#5).
meta.motivation: The taxonomy schema was implicit and scattered across Zod validators, TS types, prompt templates, PS validators, and JSON conventions — the root of a recurring bug class (edge-vocabulary sprawl, non-canonical node-ID emission, field drift, the t/3432 synthetic_phrases dual-store). The drafting inventory itself surfaced 4 live defects — t/3448 (rhetorical_strategy vocab drift), t/3449 (steelman_vulnerability str/dict type-drift), t/3450 (moral_imperative cross-field contamination), t/3451 (_phrase_regen_pending residue) — which answer the future dual-maintenance objection (SO framing note, t/3447#5 amendment 6).

sidegrammars.note: cc-node + situation id grammar is a follow-up (v1.1) section per the TL scope ruling (t/3447#2/#4) — extends the record without changing its shape.

epistemic_type.notes: Epistemic modality of the claim (AIF I-node quality). empirical_claim/predictive=assertoric+falsifiable; normative_prescription=deontic; strategic_recommendation=practical/means-end; interpretive_lens=framing; definitional=analytic; causal_mechanism=causal.

node_scope.notes: Argumentative granularity. claim=atomic I-node; scheme=AIF argumentation-scheme (S-node/RA pattern); bridging=cross-POV connector; others=abstraction breadth.

falsifiability.notes: Popperian testability qualifier; epistemic quality of the I-node.

rhetorical_strategy.notes: Rhetorical/pragmatic persuasion move (presentation layer, not propositional content). VOCAB PENDING CANONICALIZATION — t/3448 merges drift variants (pragmatic*, precautionary*, cost_benefit*, system(ic)_critique, fear_appeal, evidence_based) into this canonical set.

emotional_register.notes: Affective tone (pathos); presentational quality. t/3450 removes moral_imperative leakage (a rhetorical_strategy value contaminating this field).

audience.notes: Intended addressee(s); AIF dialogical context (target participants).

intellectual_lineage.notes: Genealogy/provenance of the idea (open set, ~63 distinct). Descriptive, not argumentative.

assumes.notes: Presuppositions. RELATIONAL content (semantically the ASSUMES edge / AIF RA-presupposition) stored node-locally as free-text — flagged for the intrinsic-vs-relational routing call (routing stays human, t/1242).

steelman_vulnerability.notes: Strongest counterargument (dialectical). RELATIONAL (semantically CONTRADICTS/WEAKENS / AIF CA) stored as node text. TYPE-DRIFT: dict on 27 nodes — t/3449 normalizes to string.

aphorism.notes: Camp-voice compressed slogan. Presentational-ONLY (t/1550: never scoring/embedding input).

possible_fallacies.notes: Fallacy tags on the node's reasoning; dialectical quality (AIF CA-type flags).

debate_tested.notes: Process/provenance metadata (test record), not ontological content.

policy_actions.notes: Refs to pol-* ids. RELATIONAL (POV->policy) stored node-locally — flagged for routing call.

attribution_text.notes: Render of description framing ('A {BDI} within {camp} discourse that...'). DERIVED-DUPLICATION — record classifies derived-or-retire; not an independent source.

synthetic_phrases.notes: 3rd-person paraphrases for matching/embedding/UI. CONTESTED HOME vs sidecar corpus_{acc,saf,skp}.json; node field being retired.

debate_grounding.notes: 1st-person own-voice grounding for the debate block. CONTESTED-HOME resolution: this=debate own-voice; sidecar=matching/retrieval/UI; retires synthetic_phrases' debate role.

_phrase_regen_pending.notes: Legal-but-ephemeral processing flag (per TL). t/3451 cleans the 27 residual instances; gate treats status:transient as non-drift.

canonical.review_by: keep/retire ontology call — near-vestigial (9/33744 uses); CL follow-up ticket (t/3447#4 tweak 2)

edges.note: 0 non-canonical types in live edges[] today; deprecated_types is present-but-empty so any sprawl re-entry (the ~70 dead llm_proposed class) surfaces as a diff, not a silent addition.
